description: Trafikverket - riksintressen för trafikslagens anläggningar is a dataset listed in Geodata Portal Sweden, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geo-ri.trafikverket.se. GeoPackage files describing the national interests of the Transport Act's facilities (aviation, railway, shipping and road). Both existing and planned and future facilities of national interest are reported. The Swedish Transport Administration's latest decision on national interests dates from 26 September 2022. Coverage: SE. The portal shows the English title as "Swedish Transport Administration - national interests in the facilities of the Transport Act" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Transport. The listing shows 2024-11-12 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geodata-se.
